fusions.name: Naphtha Jet
fusions.desc: Pumps liquid fire through a cone 3.5 tiles long, dealing 12 damage to everything in it with a 70% chance to leave each enemy [Burning] for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Sent in Ablaze
fusions.desc: Sends a burning hulk into the first enemy it meets for 30 damage, setting it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. It bursts on impact, dealing 80% of that damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Torched Rails
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are set [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Fanned by Headway
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
